pattern.description: After clicking Run Tasks, the nav drawer closes and the app content hard-swaps to the Run Tasks list through a brief translucent page-load flash; the breadcrumb updates to Integration / Run Tasks.
pattern.why_premium: Little added craft: it is raw screen-recording navigation. Its value is pacing, since the swap lands on 'Workday' in the narration and the new page is held still for reading; a premium remake would replace the page-load flash with a short crossfade or blur_crossfade.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.timeline().set('.nav-drawer, .dim-overlay', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.dashboard-page', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.run-tasks-page', {autoAlpha: 1}).set('.breadcrumb', {textContent: 'Integration / Run Tasks'}); premium alternative: fromTo('.run-tasks-page', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power1.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Use a <Sequence> cut at the click frame: frame < swapFrame renders the dashboard with drawer, frame >= swapFrame renders the Run Tasks page and new breadcrumb; optional 4-frame opacity interpolate for a softer swap. No spring.

notes: The blue translucent layer at frame 605 looks like a one-frame page-load or screen-capture artifact, not an authored transition. The 'Targets vs. Actuals' tooltip is stale UI from the earlier dashboard and does not belong to the new page. No SFX candidates.
